_cost_note: This tool meters per keyword on YOUR own Apify account. A focused ~300-keyword run costs roughly $2 to $5 (more at 1,000+ keywords), which EXCEEDS Apify's free monthly credit, so a card is required. The forecast prints the exact estimate before spending. This tool is not free; it is cheap next to a $99 to $139 per month subscription.
_input_modes: Provide EITHER seed_terms (mode 1: keywords you already know) OR a vertical (mode 2: a market label to expand from). Set location for a city-localized SERP; leave it blank for country-level.
